description: Election Commission - Declare that K. J. Kumarathunga as a member of the Kebithigollewa P/S
reasoning: This gazette notice concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Kebithigollewa Pradeshiya Sabha) due to a member's resignation, following procedures outlined in the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves the nomination and declaration of a new member through electoral processes, specifically falling under election-related administrative matters rather than central government personnel or structural changes.
